name: Padjelantaleden Etapp 3: BLT Låddejåhkå/Låddejåkkåstugan - BLT Árasluoktastugorna
description: BLT Låddejåhkå/Låddejåkkåstugan to BLT Árasluoktastugorna. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Låddejåhkå drinking water: Mapped drinking-water point near the start. Treat as mountain water with normal treatment/currentness caveats.
notes: STF and Naturkartan use 13 km; BLT/Padjelanta endpoint tables use 12 km.
STF says 3-4 hours; Naturkartan says 4-6 hours. Field reports support both depending on pace and whether stages are combined.
Naturkartan BD59 geometry endpoint is about 224 m from the Padjelanta.se hut coordinate, while OSM relation/hut coordinates are much closer to the hut.
Laponia warns about a poor-condition Miellädno bridge near Álggajávrre/Alkavare, which appears off the Stage 3 Padjelantaleden line but shares the river name.
Some BLT pages still show 2025-like staffing/payment text while Padjelanta.se Arasluokta shows 2026 dates/prices; card/cash guidance differs between pages.
